lines.zh: 我踩着碎骨一样的地面。
lines.en: I pick my way over ground like crushed bone.
These scales of mine are deep violet.
I pad along behind you in small steps.
Where it grows bright, I slow down.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比看上去更利。
lines.en: My claws are sharper than they look.

lines.zh: 我贴着地走，翼尖拖在后面。
lines.en: I go low, wingtips dragging behind.

lines.zh: 洞口的风吹得我停了一下。
lines.en: The wind at the cave mouth halts me.
I skirt around a lava crack.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，先看清路再走。
lines.en: I look first, then walk.
Every step is careful.
I flick my tail and walk on.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有细小的印。
lines.en: Small prints mark where I have been.
I lie flat and do not stir.
Firelight plays over my scales.

lines.zh: 从岩浆里孵出来，火星还挂着。
lines.en: Hatched in lava, with sparks still on me.
I fix my eyes on a moth.
I lift a foreclaw and lick it.
I know this stone passage well.
I rest my head on my tail.
I hear something far away.
I wonder how hot that egg was.
It is not you I wait for; it is the wind.

lines.zh: 鳞片的紫色在暗处更深。
lines.en: My violet scales look darker in shadow.
I flick a pebble with a claw.
My wings are half-open, ready to lift.
I close my eyes to listen, then open them.
You smell strongly of torch smoke.

lines.zh: 我是从哪个箱子来的，你记得吗？
lines.en: Do you remember which chest I came from?

lines.zh: 我的颜色和兄弟不太一样。
lines.en: My coloring differs from my kin.

lines.zh: 你把蛋放在岩浆旁，很久。
lines.en: You left the egg by the lava a long time.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，瞳孔收成一条线。
lines.en: I look up, pupils narrowed to slits.

lines.zh: 你手心朝下，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: I approach only when your palm faces down.
I know the smell of raw rabbit.

lines.zh: 你要是扔下我，我会跟着。
lines.en: If you leave me behind, I will follow anyway.
My small body can bear fire.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的高度正合适。
lines.en: You crouch to just the right height.
I do not bite those I know.
There is dust on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从箱子里孵出来，还记得火。
lines.en: I hatched from a chest and still remember fire.
The cave is cold; you are warm.
When I call, you should understand.
Do not hold me too tightly.
In the dark my eyes shine brighter.

lines.zh: 你是我第一个见到的东西。
lines.en: You were the first thing I saw.
Are we going out together?
I tilt my head and wait for you to finish.

lines.zh: 篝火孵出的我，也会怕火。
lines.en: Hatched in a campfire, and I still fear fire.
I land badly, then push up on my wings.
There is a tear in my wing membrane.
I tremble, but I do not run far.
Blood runs down between my scales.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里挤出一声低叫。
lines.en: A low cry squeezes out of my throat.
I guard my chest and back away.
I can still stand this much.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里孵出来，还热着。
lines.en: I hatched from lava, still warm.
I slump onto the top of your foot.
The smell of rabbit is very close.
I raise my head, nostrils working.
Put it in your palm and I will come.
I take it gently, not touching your hand.
This will keep me busy half a day.
Chicken will do too; I am not fussy.
I swallow too fast and choke a little.
When done, I lick my claws.
I hatched out of a campfire.
For this, I am willing to obey.
The bump set all four feet sliding.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖被踩，我甩了一下。
lines.en: My tail tip is stepped on; I flick it free.
I roll over and scramble back.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，撞不疼你。
lines.en: A body this small cannot hurt you.
I grumble and move aside.
You walk too fast for me to keep up.
My wing got pinned.
I squeeze past against your leg.
We knock against each other once.
Scale dust is on the ground.
I climb onto your shoulder.
We crowd into the same corner.
I nudge your neck with my head.
Do not laugh when I purr.
Sleep; I will watch.
We keep this fire together.
Tomorrow we go deeper still.
Your hand rests on my back.
I make a small call for you.

lines.zh: 你走慢点，我翅短追不上。
lines.en: Slow down, my wings are too short to keep up.
I snatch it and run aside.
This is shiny. I want it.

lines.zh: 这点个头，搬不动整块铁。
lines.en: At this size I can't shift a whole block of iron.
I hold it with both foreclaws.
It made a loud noise when it fell.
I set it before your feet.
Can this be eaten? Let me sniff.

lines.zh: 我把这块亮东西埋进草根。
lines.en: I bury this shiny thing at the roots of the grass.
My claw is stuck.
I am keeping this. Not giving it back.
That shadow is not a rock.
I arch my back and tuck my wings.
I am in front of you; do not block me.
It is quite a bit bigger than me.
My mouth is already growing warm.
I will make one test charge.

lines.zh: 蛋壳里孵出来的小家伙。
lines.en: A little one hatched from a shell.

lines.zh: 它没看见我贴在影子里。
lines.en: It does not see me pressed into the shadow.
Remember, I am on your left.

lines.zh: 这一口我要咬实，篝火烤过的蛋。
lines.en: This bite must land, from an egg hatched on a campfire.

lines.zh: 我刚从营火里孵出来，爪子还软。
lines.en: Just hatched from a campfire; my claws are soft.
The moment it moves, all four of my paws leave the ground.
I spit fire first to startle it.
I crouch low with my wings folded at my sides.
I know this place. Follow me.
It turned. Now.
I circle it low to the ground.
It lifts a foot and I dodge aside.
I wait for an opening.
My breathing is shallow and steady.
It misstepped once.
I draw it toward the lava.
My tail is rigid and straight.

lines.zh: 它看不见我这么小的东西。
lines.en: It cannot see something as small as me.
I count the gaps between its turns.

lines.zh: 我这身深紫鳞，在篝火边烤着。
lines.en: My deep purple scales warm by the campfire.
I go for its hind leg.
Your movement has split its attention.
My claws grip the ground.
Its shadow covers me.
I slip beneath it.
Fire churns in my belly.
There is my angle. I am going in.

lines.zh: 蛋在岩浆里孵了十分钟。
lines.en: The egg sat in lava for ten minutes.
I clamp onto its lower leg.
Fire shoots out, a short burst.
My claws rake and open its hide.
One swing of its tail sends me flying.
I land and roll back onto my feet.
That bite found only hard plating.
My flame caught it.
It swatted my wing.
I growl low and charge again.
It backs off; I am panting too.
I bite and dart away.
That one was on your behalf.
Its blood is a little hot.
I stand up, swaying.
I have only just bitten into its flank.
Back at your feet.
The shell split from within.

lines.zh: 岩浆的热气把我催了出来。
lines.en: The heat of the lava forced me out.
Violet scales emerge first.
I tumble from the shell onto cold ground.
My wings are not stiff yet, and I can barely stand.

lines.zh: 我从箱子里的一枚蛋来的。
lines.en: I came from an egg in a chest.
The stone walls around are so tall.
I cough and sparks fly out.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，空气是苦的。
lines.en: My first breath — the air is bitter.
I am standing on my own shell.
I look up and see firelight.
This is where I was born.
I try spreading my wings.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，先暖暖身子。
lines.en: I curl up to warm myself first.
Someone is watching nearby.
I crawl toward him.

lines.zh: 地面是硬的，爪下有碎石。
lines.en: The ground is hard, gravel under my claws.
I give a tiny call.
This fire is not mine, and it burns.

lines.zh: 摔下来的时候尾巴先着地。
lines.en: I landed tail-first.

lines.zh: 我在水里乱抓，抓不到边。
lines.en: I claw at the water and find no edge.
The blast throws me against rock.

lines.zh: 一根细东西扎进我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something thin pierced my wing.
A cold crawling thing is inside me.
My belly is empty and my legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷声滚过，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The thunder rolls past and my ears ring.
I keep falling and falling.
